mapper.select: select release_id, media_id, platform, platform_logo, country, offer_type, online_date, link, status, source from km_media_release where media_id = #{mediaId} order by field(status,'available','upcoming','offline'), online_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into km_media_release (media_id, platform, platform_logo, country, offer_type, online_date, link, status, source, create_time) values (#{mediaId}, #{platform}, #{platformLogo}, #{country}, #{offerType}, #{onlineDate}, #{link}, #{status}, ifnull(#{source},'tmdb'), sysdate())

insert ignore into km_media_release (media_id, platform, platform_logo, country, offer_type, online_date, link, status, source, create_time) values (#{mediaId}, #{platform}, #{platformLogo}, #{country}, #{offerType}, #{onlineDate}, #{link}, #{status}, 'justwatch', sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from km_media_release where media_id = #{mediaId} and (source is null or source = 'tmdb')
delete from km_media_release where media_id = #{mediaId} and source = 'custom'
delete from km_media_release where platform = #{platform} and source = 'custom'
mapper.update: update km_media_release set platform = #{newName}, update_time = sysdate() where platform = #{oldName} and source = 'custom'
update km_media_release set platform_logo = #{logo}, update_time = sysdate() where platform = #{platform} and source = 'custom'
update km_media_release set link = #{link}, update_time = sysdate() where platform = #{platform} and source = 'custom'
mapper.select: select platform_logo from km_media_release where platform = #{platform} and platform_logo like '/profile%' limit 1
mapper.update: update km_media_release set platform_logo = #{logo}, update_time = sysdate() where platform = #{platform}
